mn54:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Aṅguttarāpesu viharati; Āpaṇaṃ nāma Aṅguttarāpānaṃ nigamo.
mn54:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya Āpaṇaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
mn54:2.2: Āpaṇe piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yen' aññataro vanasaṇḍo ten' upasaṅkami divāvihārāya,
mn54:2.3: taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ ajjhogāhitvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi.
mn54:3.1: Potaliyo pi kho gahapati sampannanivāsapāvuraṇo chattupāhanāhi jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno yena so vanasaṇḍo ten' upasaṅkami, taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ ajjhogāhitvā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi,
mn54:3.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho Potaliyaṃ gahapatiṃ Bhagavā etad-avoca:
mn54:3.3: Saṃvijjante kho gahapati āsanāni, sace ākaṅkhasi nisīdāti.
mn54:3.4: Evaṃ vutte Potaliyo gahapati: gahapativādena maṃ samaṇo Gotamo samudācaratīti kupito anattamano tuṇhī ahosi.
mn54:3.6: kho Bhagavā Potaliyaṃ gahapatiṃ etad-avoca: Saṃvijjante kho gahapati āsaṇāni, sace ākaṅkhasi nisīdāti. Dutiyam-pi kho Potaliyo gahapati: gahapativādena maṃ samaṇo Gotamo samudācaratīti kupito anattamano tuṇhī ahosi. Tatiyam-pi kho Bhagavā Potaliyaṃ gahapatiṃ etad-avoca:
mn54:3.7: Saṃvijjante kho gahapati āsanāni, sace ākaṅkhasi nisīdāti.
mn54:3.8: Evaṃ vutte Potaliyo gahapati: gahapativādena maṃ samaṇo Gotamo samudācaratīti kupito anattamano Bhagavantaṃ etad-avoca:
mn54:3.9: Ta-y-idaṃ bho Gotama na-cchannaṃ, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ ta-y-idaṃ na-ppatirūpaṃ, yaṃ maṃ tvaṃ gahapativādena samudācarasīti. --
mn54:3.10: Te hi te gahapati ākārā te liṅgā te nimittā yathā taṃ gahapatissāti.
mn54:3.11: -Tathā hi pana me bho Gotama sabbe kammantā paṭikkhittā sabbe vohārā samucchinnā ti. --
mn54:3.12: Yathākathaṃ pana te gahapati sabbe kammantā paṭikkhittā sabbe vohārā samucchinnā ti. --
mn54:3.13: Idha me bho Gotama yaṃ ahosi dhanaṃ vā dhaññaṃ vā rajataṃ vā jātarūpaṃ vā sabban-taṃ puttānaṃ dāyajjaṃ niyyātaṃ, tatthāhaṃ anovādī anupavādī ghāsacchādanaparamo viharāmi.
mn54:3.14: Evaṃ kho me bho Gotama sabbe kammantā paṭikkhittā sabbe vohārā samucchinnā ti.
mn54:3.15: -Aññathā kho tvaṃ gahapati vohārasamucchedaṃ vadasi aññathā ca pana ariyassa vinaye vohārasamucchedo hotīti.
mn54:3.16: -Yathākathaṃ pana bhante ariyassa vinaye vohārasamucchedo hoti.
mn54:3.17: Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā tathā dhammaṃ desetu yathā ariyassa vinaye vohārasamucchedo hotīti. --
mn54:3.18: Tena hi gahapati suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi, bhāsissāmīti.
mn54:3.19: Evaṃ bhante ti kho Potaliyo gahapati Bhagavato paccassosi.
mn54:4.2: Aṭṭha kho ime gahapati dhammā ariyassa vinaye vohārasamucchedāya saṃvattanti,
mn54:4.7: apisuṇaṃ vācaṃ nissāya pisuṇā vācā pahātabbā,
mn54:4.12: Ime kho gahapati aṭṭha dhammā saṅkhittena vuttā vitthārena avibhattā ariyassa vinaye vohārasamucchedāya saṃvattantīti. --
mn54:5.1: Ye 'me bhante Bhagavatā aṭṭha dhammā saṅkhittena vuttā vitthārena avibhattā ariyassa vinaye vohārasamucchedāya saṃvattanti, sādhu me bhante Bhagavā ime aṭṭha dhamme vitthārena vibhajatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
mn54:5.2: -Tena hi gahapati suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi, bhāsissāmīti.
mn54:5.3: Evaṃ bhante ti kho Potaliyo gahapati Bhagavato paccassosi.
mn54:6.1: Apāṇātipātaṃ nissāya pāṇāṭipāto pahātabbo ti iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñ-c' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ:
mn54:6.3: Yesaṃ kho ahaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ hetu pāṇātipātī assaṃ tesāhaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya paṭipanno;
mn54:6.4: ahañ-c' eva kho pana pāṇātipātī assaṃ, attā pi maṃ upavadeyya pāṇātipātapaccayā, anuvicca viññū garaheyyuṃ pāṇātipātapaccayā, kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā pāṇātipātapaccayā.
mn54:6.5: Etadeva kho pana saṃyojanaṃ etaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ yadidaṃ pāṇātipāto,
mn54:6.6: ye ca pāṇātipātapaccayā uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā pāṇātipātā paṭiviratassa evaṃ-sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
mn54:6.8: iti yan-taṃ vuttaṃ idam-etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn54:7.1: Dinnādānaṃ nissāya adinnādānaṃ pahātabban-ti iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñ-c' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ:
mn54:7.3: Yesaṃ kho ahaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ hetu adinnādāyī assaṃ tesāhaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya paṭipanno;
mn54:7.4: ahañ-c' eva kho pana adinnādāyī assaṃ, attā pi maṃ upavadeyya adinnādānapaccayā, anuvicca viññū garaheyyuṃ adinnādānapaccayā, kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā adinnādānapaccayā.
mn54:7.5: Etad-eva kho pana saṃyojanaṃ etaṃ nivaraṇaṃ yadidaṃ adinnādānaṃ,
mn54:7.6: ye ca adinnādānapaccayā uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā adinnādānā paṭiviratassa evaṃ-sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
mn54:7.8: iti yan-taṃ vuttaṃ idam-etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn54:8.1: Saccaṃ vācaṃ nissāya musāvādo pahātabbo ti iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñ-c' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ:
mn54:8.3: Yesaṃ kho ahaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ hetu musāvādī assaṃ tesāhaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya paṭipanno;
mn54:8.4: ahañ-c' eva kho pana musāvādī assaṃ, attā pi maṃ upavadeyya musāvādapaccayā, anuvicca viññū garaheyyuṃ musāvādapaccayā, kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā musāvādapaccayā.
mn54:8.5: Etadeva kho pana saṃyojanaṃ etaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ yadidaṃ musāvādo, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn54:8.6: ye ca musāvādapaccayā uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā musāvādā paṭiviratassa evaṃ-sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
mn54:8.7: Saccaṃ vācaṃ nissāya musāvādo pahātabbo ti
mn54:8.8: iti yan-taṃ vuttaṃ idam-etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn54:9.1: Apisuṇaṃ vācaṃ nissāya pisuṇā vācā pahātabbā ti iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñ-c' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ:
mn54:9.3: Yesaṃ kho ahaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ hetu pisuṇāvāco assaṃ tesāhaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya paṭipanno;
mn54:9.4: ahañ-c' eva kho pana pisuṇāvāco assaṃ, attā pi maṃ upavadeyya pisuṇāvācāpaccayā, anuvicca viññū garaheyyuṃ pisuṇāvācāpaccayā, kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā pisuṇāvācāpaccayā.
mn54:9.5: Etadeva kho pana saṃyojanaṃ etaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ yadidaṃ pisuṇā vācā,
mn54:9.6: ye ca pisuṇāvācāpaccayā uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā pisuṇāya vācāya paṭiviratassa evaṃ-sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
mn54:9.7: Apisuṇaṃ vācaṃ nissāya pisuṇā vācā pahātabbā ti
mn54:9.8: iti yan-taṃ vuttaṃ idam-etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn54:10.1: Agiddhilobhaṃ nissāya giddhilobho pahātabbo ti iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñ-c' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ:
mn54:10.3: Yesaṃ kho ahaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ hetu giddhilobhī assaṃ tesāhaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya paṭipanno;
mn54:10.4: ahañ-c' eva kho pana giddhilobhī assaṃ, attā pi maṃ upavadeyya giddhilobhapaccayā, anuvicca viññū garaheyyuṃ giddhilobhapaccayā, kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā giddhilobhapaccayā.
mn54:10.5: Etad-eva kho pana saṃyojanaṃ etaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ yadidaṃ giddhilobho,
mn54:10.6: ye ca giddhilobhapaccayā uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā agiddhilobhissa evaṃ-sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
mn54:10.8: iti yan-taṃ vuttaṃ idam-etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.

mn54:11.3: Yesaṃ kho ahaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ hetu nindārosī assaṃ tesāhaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya paṭipanno; \ [...

mn54:12.1: Akodhupāyāsaṃ nissāya kodhupāyāso pahātabbo ti iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñ-c' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ:
mn54:12.3: Yesaṃ kho ahaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ hetu kodhupāyāsī assaṃ tesāhaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya paṭipanno;
mn54:12.4: ahañ-c' eva kho pana kodhupāyāsī assaṃ, attā pi maṃ upavadeyya kodhupāyāsapaccayā, anuvicca viññū garaheyyuṃ kodhupāyāsapaccayā, kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā kodhupāyāsapaccayā.
mn54:12.5: Etad-eva kho pana saṃyojanaṃ etaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ yadidaṃ kodhupāyāso,
mn54:12.6: ye ca kodhupāyāsapaccayā uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā akodhupāyāsissa evaṃ-sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
mn54:12.8: iti yan-taṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn54:13.1: Anatimānaṃ nissāya atimāno pahātabbo ti iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñ-c' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ:
mn54:13.3: Yesaṃ kho ahaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ hetu atimānī assaṃ tesāhaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya paṭipanno;
mn54:13.4: ahañ-c' eva kho pana atimānī assaṃ, attā pi maṃ upavadeyya atimānapaccayā, anuvicca viññū garaheyyuṃ atimānapaccayā, kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā atimānapaccayā.
mn54:13.5: Etadeva kho pana saṃyojanaṃ etaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ yadidaṃ atimāno,
mn54:13.6: ye ca atimānapaccayā uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā anatimānissa evaṃ-sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
mn54:13.8: iti yan-taṃ vuttaṃ idam-etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn54:14.1: Ime kho gahapati aṭṭha dhammā saṅkhittena vuttā vitthārena vibhattā ye ariyassa vinaye vohārasamucchedāya saṃvattanti,
mn54:14.2: na tv-eva tāva ariyassa vinaye sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ vohārasamucchedo hotīti. --
mn54:14.3: Yathākathaṃ pana bhante ariyassa vinaye sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ vohārasamucchedo hoti.
mn54:14.4: Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā tathā dhammaṃ desetu yathā ariyassa vinaye sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ vohārasamucchedo hotīti. --
mn54:14.5: Tena hi gahapati suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi, bhāsissāmīti.
mn54:14.6: Evaṃ bhante ti kho Potaliyo gahapati Bhagavato paccassosi.
mn54:15.1: Seyyathā pi gahapati kukkuro jighacchādubbalyapareto goghātakasūnaṃ paccupaṭṭhito assa,
mn54:15.2: tam-enaṃ dakkho goghātako vā goghātakantevāsī vā aṭṭhikaṅkalaṃ sunikantaṃ nikantaṃ nimmaṃsaṃ lohitamakkhitaṃ upacchubheyya;
mn54:15.4: api nu so kukkuro amuṃ aṭṭhikaṅkalaṃ sunikantaṃ nikantaṃ nimmaṃsaṃ lohitamakkhitaṃ palikhādanto jighacchādubbalyaṃ paṭivineyyāti. --
mn54:15.7: aduṃ hi bhante aṭṭhikaṅkalaṃ sunikantaṃ nikantaṃ nimmaṃsaṃ lohitamakkhitaṃ,
mn54:15.8: yāvad-eva ca pana so kukkuro kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī assāti. --
mn54:15.9: Evam-eva kho gahapati ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn54:15.10: Aṭṭhikaṅkalūpamā kāmā vuttā Bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo ti
mn54:15.11: evam-etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā yā 'yaṃ upekhā nānattā nānattasitā taṃ abhinivajjetvā yā 'yaṃ upekhā ekattā ekattasitā yattha sabbaso lokāmisupādānā aparisesā nirujjhanti tam-ev' upekhaṃ bhāveti.
mn54:16.1: Seyyathā pi gahapati gijjho vā kaṅko vā kulalo vā maṃsapesiṃ ādāya uḍḍayeyya,
mn54:16.2: tam-enaṃ gijjhā pi kaṅkā pi kulalā pi anupatitvā anupatitvā vitaccheyyuṃ virājeyyuṃ;
mn54:16.4: sace so gijjho vā kaṅko vā kulalo vā taṃ maṃsapesiṃ na khippam-eva paṭinissajeyya so tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhan-ti. --
mn54:16.6: Evam-eva kho gahapati ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn54:16.7: Maṃsapesūpamā kāmā vuttā Bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo ti
mn54:16.8: evam-etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā yā 'yaṃ upekhā nānattā nānattasitā taṃ abhinivajjetvā yā 'yaṃ upekhā ekattā ekattasitā yattha sabbaso lokāmisupādānā aparisesā nirujjhanti tam-ev' upekhaṃ bhāveti. \ [...
mn54:17.1: content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ Seyyathā pi gahapati puriso ādittaṃ tiṇukkaṃ ādāya paṭivātaṃ gaccheyya;
mn54:17.3: sace so puriso taṃ ādittaṃ tiṇukkaṃ na khippam-eva paṭinissajeyya tassa sā ādittā tiṇukkā hatthaṃ vā daheyya bāhaṃ vā daheyya aññataraṃ vā aṅgapaccaṅgaṃ daheyya, so tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhan-ti.
mn54:17.5: Evam-eva kho gahapati ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn54:17.6: Tiṇukkūpamā kāmā vuttā Bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo ti
mn54:17.7: evam-etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā --pe-- tam-ev' upekhaṃ bhāveti.
mn54:18.1: Seyyathā pi gahapati aṅgārakāsu sādhikaporisā pūrā aṅgārānaṃ vītaccikānaṃ vītadhūmānaṃ,
mn54:18.2: atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitukāmo amaritukāmo sukhakāmo dukkhapaṭikkūlo,
mn54:18.3: tam-enaṃ dve balavanto purisā nānābāhāsu gahetvā aṅgārakāsuṃ upakaḍḍheyyuṃ;
mn54:18.5: api nu so puriso iti c' iti c' eva kāyaṃ sannāmeyyāti. --
mn54:18.8: viditaṃ hi bhante tassa purisassa: imañ-ca ahaṃ aṅgārakāsuṃ papatissāmi tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchāmi maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhan-ti. --
mn54:18.9: Evam-eva kho gahapati ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn54:18.10: Aṅgārakāsūpamā kāmā vuttā Bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo ti
mn54:18.11: evam-etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā --pe-- tam-ev' upekhaṃ bhāveti.
mn54:19.1: Seyyathā pi gahapati puriso supinakaṃ passeyya, ārāmarāmaṇeyyakaṃ vanarāmaṇeyyakaṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ pokkharaṇīrāmaṇeyyakaṃ,
mn54:19.3: evam-eva kho gahapati ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn54:19.4: Supinakūpamā kāmā vuttā Bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo ti evam-etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā --pe--
mn54:20.1: Seyyathā pi gahapati puriso yācitakaṃ bhogaṃ yācitvā yānaṃ poroseyyaṃ pavaramaṇikuṇḍalaṃ
mn54:20.2: so tehi yācitakehi bhogehi purakkhato parivuto antarāpaṇaṃ paṭipajjeyya, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn54:20.4: bhogī vata bho puriso, evaṃkira bhogino bhogāni bhuñjantīti,
mn54:20.5: tam-enaṃ sāmikā yattha yatth' eva passeyyuṃ tattha tatth' eva sāni hareyyuṃ;
mn54:20.6: taṃ kim-maññasi gahapati: alan-nu kho tassa purisassa aññathattāyāti. --
mn54:20.10: Evam-eva kho gahapati ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn54:20.11: Yācitakūpamā kāmā vuttā Bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo ti evam-etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā --pe--
mn54:21.1: Seyyathā pi gahapati gāmassa vā nigamassa vā avidūre tibbo vanasaṇḍo,
mn54:21.2: tatr' assa rukkho sampannaphalo ca upapannaphalo ca, na cāssu kānici phalāni bhūmiyaṃ patitāni,
mn54:21.3: atha puriso āgaccheyya phalatthiko phalagavesī phalapariyesanaṃ caramāno,
mn54:21.4: so taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ ajjhogāhitvā taṃ rukkhaṃ passeyya sampannaphalañ-ca upapannaphalañ-ca,
mn54:21.6: ayaṃ kho rukkho sampannaphalo ca upapannaphalo ca, na-tthi ca kānici phalāni bhūmiyaṃ patitāni,
mn54:21.8: yan-nūnāhaṃ imaṃ rukkhaṃ ārohitvā yāvadatthañ-ca khādeyyaṃ ucchaṅgañ-ca pūreyyan-ti;
mn54:21.9: so taṃ rukkhaṃ ārohitvā yāvadatthañ-ca khādeyya ucchaṅgañ-ca pūreyya.
mn54:21.10: Atha dutiyo puriso āgaccheyya phalatthiko phalagavesī phalapariyesanaṃ caramāno tiṇhaṃ kuṭhāriṃ ādāya,
mn54:21.11: so taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ ajjhogāhitvā taṃ rukkhaṃ passeyya sampannaphalañ-ca upapannaphalañca,
mn54:21.13: ayaṃ kho rukkho sampannaphalo ca upapannaphalo ca, na-tthi ca kānici phalāni bhūmiyaṃ patitāni,
mn54:21.14: na kho panāhaṃ jānāmi rukkhaṃ ārohituṃ,
mn54:21.15: yan-nūnāhaṃ imaṃ rukkhaṃ mūlato chetvā yāvadatthañ-ca khādeyyaṃ ucchaṅgañ-ca pūreyyan-ti;
mn54:21.18: asu yo so puriso paṭhamaṃ rukkhaṃ ārūḷho sace so na khippam-eva oroheyya tassa so rukkho papatanto hatthaṃ vā bhañjeyya pādaṃ vā bhañjeyya aññataraṃ vā aṅgapaccaṅgam bhañjeyya, so tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ va nigaccheyya maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhanti. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ --
mn54:21.20: Evam-eva kho gahapati ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn54:21.21: Rukkhaphalūpamā kāmā vuttā Bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo ti
mn54:21.22: evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā yā 'yaṃ upekhā nānattā nānattasitā taṃ abhinivajjetvā yā 'yaṃ upekhā ekattā ekattasitā yattha sabbaso lokāmisupādānā aparisesā nirujjhanti tam-ev' upekhaṃ bhāveti.
mn54:22.1: Sa kho so gahapati ariyasāvako imaṃ yeva anuttaraṃ upekhāsatipārisuddhiṃ āgamma anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati,
mn54:22.2: seyyathīdaṃ ekam-pi jātiṃ dve pi jātiyo tisso pi jātiyo --pe-- iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
mn54:23.1: Sa kho so gahapati ariyasāvako imaṃ yeva anuttaraṃ upekhāsatipārisuddhiṃ āgamma dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne, hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate --pe-- yathākammūpage satte pajānāti.
mn54:24.1: Sa kho so gahapati ariyasāvako imaṃ yeva anuttaraṃ upekhāsatipārisuddhiṃ āgamma āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
mn54:25.1: Ettāvatā kho gahapati ariyassa vinaye sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ vohārasamucchedo hoti.
mn54:25.3: yathā ariyassa vinaye sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ vohārasamucchedo hoti, api nu tvaṃ evarūpaṃ vohārasamucchedaṃ attani samanupassasīti. --
mn54:25.4: Ko cāhaṃ bhante ko ca ariyassa vinaye sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ vohārasamucchedo.
mn54:25.5: Ārakā 'haṃ bhante ariyassa vinaye sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ vohārasamucchedā.
mn54:25.6: Mayaṃ hi bhante pubbe aññatitthiye paribbājake anājānīye va samāne ājānīyā ti amaññimha, anājānīye va samāne ājānīyabhojanaṃ bhojimha, anājānīye va samāne ājānīyaṭṭhāne ṭhapimha;
mn54:25.7: bhikkhū pana-mayaṃ bhante ājānīye va samāne anājānīyā ti amaññimha, ājānīye va samāne anājānīyabhojanaṃ bhojimha, ājānīye va samāne anājānīyaṭṭhāne ṭhapimha.

mn54:25.9: bhikkhū pana mayaṃ bhante ājānīye va samāne ājānīyā ti jānissāma, ājānīye va samāne ājānīyabhojanaṃ bhojissāma, ājānīye va samāne ājānīyaṭṭhāne ṭhapissāma.
mn54:25.10: Ajanesi vata me bhante Bhagavā samaṇesu samaṇapemaṃ, samaṇesu samaṇappasādaṃ, samaṇesu samaṇagāravaṃ.
mn54:26.2: Seyyathā pi bhante nikujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya: cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti, evam-evaṃ Bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
mn54:26.3: Esāhaṃ bhante Bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ-ca bhikkhusaṅghañ-ca.
